SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-09-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-09-2019 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF CONRAD MCKINNON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ALEX FIORE IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-09-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MCKINNON, CONRAD RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FIORE, ALEX $1,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $175.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,675.00, DEFENDANT MAY REDUCT FOR CLEANING FEES ONLY. THE NECESSITY OF THE REMAINING ITEMS WAS NOT PROVED BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF'S COURT COSTS REDUCED FOR EXCESSIVE SERVICE COST. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-02-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, THE JUDGMENT IN THIS ACTION HAS BEEN PAID IN FULL OR OTHERWISE SATISFIED. AS TO DEFENDANT FIORE, ALEX
